title: AI portfolio review: owner interviews and AI-001 action and performance data
source_system: Interviews with use case owners; AI triage action log and analyst labels (2026-01-01 to 2026-06-30)
what_it_shows: Owners' descriptions of each use case, its data and its human oversight; for AI-001, 91% precision of high-score alerts against analyst labels, 61 automated host isolations in G1 with 3 reversed as false positives, suspension rate ratios of 1.6 and 1.4 for two free-tier sign-up countries, and no adversarial test results; for AI-006, a false-positive rate for sign-ups from three countries about twice the overall rate

title: Control assessment: Account management samples and privileged grant analytic
source_system: Identity governance workflows; G1 role catalog; PAM grant export; HR and contractor termination records; Director of Identity and Access Management interview
what_it_shows: 60 sampled G1 account events matched approved requests, role templates and U.S.-person attributes; 1 of 60 sampled terminations (a contractor) was disabled 2 business days late, with contractor terminations relying on a supplier email notice; the quarterly privileged role review did not flag 4 standing privileged grants in G1 outside just-in-time elevation

title: Control assessment: Operator access request sample
source_system: G1 policy engine configuration; access request logs
what_it_shows: Each of 25 sampled operator accesses to tenant resources (of 1,186) had a customer-approved request and was logged

title: Control assessment: Release separation of duties analytic
source_system: Release role matrix; fleet automation approval records; Vice President, Software Supply Chain interview
what_it_shows: All 196 host releases had two approvers from different teams; all 18 guest-agent releases were approved by a member of the authoring team, whose access authorizations let it author and approve its own channel releases

title: Control assessment: PAM elevation sample
what_it_shows: 25 sampled PAM elevation sessions to G1 (of 8,420) were time-limited, recorded and matched a ticket

title: Control assessment: Remote access path review
what_it_shows: All 3 remote access paths into G1 management terminate on PAM bastions with MFA and recording

title: Control assessment: Event logging test
what_it_shows: Event types are defined, coordinated with the SOC and reviewed annually; 6 event types generated in test on control plane, host and KMS components were recorded

title: Control assessment: Auto-closed alert sample and hunt records
source_system: SOC review records; AI triage auto-close log; Director of Security Operations interview
what_it_shows: Weekly hunts and review of escalated alerts were performed and reported in the 5 sampled weeks; low-score alert classes are auto-closed without analyst review, and 2 of 60 sampled auto-closed G1 alerts (of about 46,000) should have been escalated, both low severity with no impact found on follow-up

title: Control assessment: Log archive protection test
what_it_shows: The G1 log archive is write-once; deletion needs two administrators, and the deletion attempt by a test administrator raised an alert

title: Control assessment: Release approval attribution analytic
source_system: Fleet automation approval records; signing logs
what_it_shows: Approvals for all 214 G1 channel releases are logged by username only and are not bound to the approver by a signature

title: Control assessment: Log source latency analytic
source_system: Log pipeline configuration; SIEM source latency report
what_it_shows: All 212 G1 log sources generate audit records, with event selection limited to the SOC and system owners; 14 storage array management sources reach the G1 log partition up to 6 hours late, outside the 15-minute STD-01.4 standard

title: Control assessment: FedRAMP independent assessment review
source_system: FedRAMP independent assessment report 2026-03; assessment plan
what_it_shows: The 2026-03 FedRAMP independent assessment was planned, performed and reported, with its assessment plan

title: Control assessment: Continuous monitoring review
what_it_shows: Continuous monitoring strategy, metrics and ongoing assessments are in place for the 3 sampled months; security status is reported monthly under the legacy process, and no Ongoing Certification Report or Quarterly Review under the 2026 CCM rules has been produced

title: Control assessment: Baseline review
what_it_shows: Baselines for 5 component types are documented, under configuration control and reviewed

title: Control assessment: Change and guest-agent release sample
what_it_shows: 60 sampled G1 changes (of 1,380) were reviewed, documented and retained, and the change board meets weekly; all 18 guest-agent channel releases were approved by one approver from the authoring team, and the security impact review required by STD-01.9 was not recorded for 5 of them

title: Control assessment: Change access trace
what_it_shows: 25 sampled changes traced to pipeline or PAM sessions; physical restrictions to G1 data halls enforced; release managers for the guest-agent channel can promote their own builds to production

title: Control assessment: Host baseline inspection
what_it_shows: Settings are documented and monitored daily; 6 of 25 sampled G1 hosts had BMC settings drifted from baseline, with drift alerted but not reverted

title: Control assessment: Host service and port scan
source_system: Host image service list; port scans
what_it_shows: The host image and the 10 scanned hosts enable only required services and ports

title: Control assessment: Physical component trace
what_it_shows: Inventory accurate for in-service components and reviewed continuously; 2 of 60 traced components (spare servers in the G1-B cage) were not in the inventory

title: Control assessment: G1 contingency test review
what_it_shows: The 2026-06 G1 contingency test was run, its results reviewed and corrective actions opened

title: Control assessment: Backup sample and restore observation
source_system: Backup job reports; vault restore test
what_it_shows: 25 sampled daily G1 backup jobs (of 181) completed and were protected; the vault copy was current; the observed restore completed

title: Control assessment: G1 recovery time review
what_it_shows: Reconstitution to a known state was demonstrated; the G1 tenant database recovered in 3.4 hours against the 2-hour RTO from the BIA (P05 BP-03)

title: Control assessment: Sign-in sample
what_it_shows: FIDO2 MFA was required for each of 25 sampled sign-ins by workforce with G1 roles

title: Control assessment: Authenticator and default credential test
source_system: Credential scanner results; out-of-band device test
what_it_shows: Authenticators are managed centrally with secrets in the vault; the credential test of 148 G1 network and out-of-band devices found default credentials on 2 out-of-band console servers in G1-B (reported to the CISO 2026-08-05)

title: Control assessment: Incident handling sample
source_system: SOC case records; IR plan v7
what_it_shows: 25 sampled G1 security incidents (of 96) were handled through all phases with lessons learned

title: Control assessment: Incident reporting review
what_it_shows: Staff report suspected incidents within 1 hour; the 2 reportable incidents since 2026-08-03 were reported on time for Class C; Initial Incident Reports took 22 to 41 minutes in the 3 drills, against the Class D target of 15 minutes for PAIN 3 to 5

title: Control assessment: Incident response plan and materiality worksheet review
source_system: IR plan v7; materiality worksheet; interviews with the General Counsel, CFO, CISO, and Director of FedRAMP Compliance
what_it_shows: Draft plan v7 designates roles and covers distribution and protection; the plan and the materiality worksheet do not address the multi-tenant factors (SLA credits, churn, federal certification impact) or AQ-1 reporting lines, and the plan is not yet updated for the Class D reporting timeframes

title: Control assessment: Nonlocal maintenance session analytic
source_system: PAM session list; vendor access logs
what_it_shows: The 214 nonlocal maintenance sessions in G1 were approved, strongly authenticated and terminated; 31 storage array vendor diagnostic sessions bypassed PAM recording

title: Control assessment: Badge event sample and site walkthrough
source_system: Badge logs; site walkthrough at G1-A and G1-B
what_it_shows: 25 sampled badge events at G1 data hall doors (of 2,104 in one week) and walkthroughs of G1-A and G1-B: access enforced with badge and biometric; visitors escorted

title: Control assessment: Termination sample
source_system: HR and contractor termination records; identity governance logs
what_it_shows: Credentials were revoked and property retrieved for the 60 sampled terminations (same sample as AC-2); 1 (a contractor) was disabled 2 business days after the termination date

title: Control assessment: Risk assessment review
what_it_shows: The 2026 enterprise risk assessment (P01) was performed, documented and reviewed

title: Control assessment: Vulnerability remediation sample
what_it_shows: Scanning, analysis and sharing operate as designed; 7 of 60 sampled vulnerabilities (of 3,912 closed 2026-02 to 2026-07) were remediated after the Class D timeframe for their PAIN rating

title: Control assessment: External service review
what_it_shows: Security requirements are in the contracts for the 14 external services supporting G1; the annual SOC report review is overdue for 3 of the 14 (26 tier-1 reviews overdue enterprise-wide)

title: Control assessment: Release sample
what_it_shows: 25 sampled G1 channel releases had integrity of changes documented and controlled, with flaws tracked; the guest-agent channel can release changes approved only within the authoring team

title: Control assessment: Boundary rule review and reachability test
source_system: Firewall rules; reachability test from the corporate jump zone
what_it_shows: External interfaces are monitored and controlled; one allow rule from the corporate jump zone to the G1 management network was broader than the approved flow (reported to the CISO 2026-08-11)

title: Control assessment: TLS scan of G1 endpoints
what_it_shows: All G1 external endpoints use TLS 1.2 or later

title: Control assessment: Key ceremony review
source_system: Key ceremony records; HSM audit logs
what_it_shows: The 4 key ceremonies in 2026 used dual control, with keys generated and held in HSMs

title: Control assessment: Cryptographic module review
what_it_shows: Cryptographic uses are identified for the 52 FR-2 services; 2 use a library update stream whose CMVP validation is pending

title: Control assessment: Encryption at rest inspection
what_it_shows: Volume, object and backup encryption at rest is on by default

title: Control assessment: KEV remediation review
what_it_shows: Flaws are identified, tested and remediated through the pipeline; 2 of the 14 KEVs affecting G1 in 2026 were remediated after the CISA due date

title: Control assessment: EDR coverage sample
source_system: EDR console; host management server coverage
what_it_shows: EDR was installed, updated and reporting on 25 sampled G1 host management servers (of 312)

title: Control assessment: Automated host isolation review
source_system: Detection catalog; AI triage action log
what_it_shows: Network, host and identity monitoring is deployed; the 61 automated host isolations in G1 ran without analyst review of the detected event, and 3 were reversed as false positives after customer impact of 40 to 95 minutes

title: Control assessment: Integrity monitoring and response review
what_it_shows: Integrity verification tools detect unauthorized changes to software, firmware and information; no automated response (for example, halting a guest-agent rollout) is configured for unauthorized changes detected in the release pipeline

title: Control assessment: Supply chain procedures and receiving walkthrough
source_system: Supply chain procedures; G1 receiving walkthrough
what_it_shows: Supply chain processes are defined and documented; receiving observed at G1-A included no tamper-evidence check on server deliveries

title: Control assessment: Supplier assessment review
what_it_shows: Assessments for 3 of the 14 G1 suppliers are past their annual date

title: Control assessment: Component source review
source_system: Internal mirror policy; dependency scan reports
what_it_shows: Components for 10 traced builds were pulled only from the internal mirror with provenance checks

title: Control assessment: Training records and phishing results
what_it_shows: 25 sampled training records of workforce with G1 roles were complete; phishing exercises ran monthly in the 6 months examined

title: Control assessment: SSP review
what_it_shows: Draft SSP v3.0 is current, distributed, reviewed and protected; conversion to the FedRAMP Security Decision Record is tracked separately (POAM-020)

title: Control assessment: Drive sanitization sample
what_it_shows: 25 sampled drives retired from G1 in 2026 (of 1,860) were sanitized per NIST SP 800-88 Rev. 2 and destroyed with certificates
